1110: {WHISPERS UNDER DA HEARIN', IN A TONGUE DAT HAB NO GRAMMAR | A MURMUR FROM BEHIND, THOUGH NUTTIN' STANDS BEHIND DEM}. {DA MIND TURNS TA LISTEN AN' NO CAN TURN BACK | DA BARDS OF ERIU RAISED BLISTERS WIT A SATIRE; DIS CUTS DEEPER}!
1111: {LOOK AT ME, DA VOICE SAYS, AN' DERE IZ NO CHOICE BUT TA LOOK | ONE LINE, DELIVERED RIGHT, AN' PRIDE DOES DA REST}. {DA FOOLS OF DA OLD COURTS SPOKE TRUTHS DAT KINGS COULD NO LEAVE UNANSWERED | COME AN' SILENCE ME, IF YOU CAN}!
1112: {LIFT, ARCH, AN' BRING DA HEAVENS DOWN ON HIM | DA BRIDGE HOLDS, AN' DA MAN ON IT DOES NO}. {MILO OF CROTON CARRIED DA BULL; CARRY DIS ONE INTO DA MAT | DA TITLE IZ EARNED ON DA BACK OF EVERY MAN THROWN}!
1113: {UP WIT DA MOON, DEN OVER AN' DOWN LIKE ITS FALLIN' LIGHT | TURN IN DA AIR AS DA MOON TURNS IN DA SKY}. {NUTTIN' DAT FLIES IZ BEYOND DA REACH OF ONE WHO FLIES HIGHER | COME DOWN ON DEM FROM WHERE DEY THOUGHT DEY WAZ SAFE}!

1115: {DA LAST NUMBER, AN' NO ONE IN DA HOUSE WILL MOVE | HOLD DA MOMENT UNTIL DA WORLD FORGETS TA BREATHE}. {AFTER DIS, DERE IZ NUTTIN' BUT DA SILENCE OF DA STUNNED | DA STAGE GOES STILL, AN' SO DO DEY}!
1116: {EVERY HOLD ME KNOW, AN' ME KNOW DEM ALL | LOCK DA JOINT, LOCK DA BREATH, AN' WAIT}. {DA PANKRATION MASTERS OF OLYMPIA WON BY SURRENDER | WE GO DOWN TOGETHER, AN' ONLY ONE OF US GETS UP}!
1117: {GOLD AN' LEATHER, DA WEIGHT OF EVERY MAN WHO EVER WANTED IT | DIS BELT WAZ WON IN BLOOD, AN' IT WILL BE DEFENDED IN BLOOD}. {SWING IT AS A KING WOULD SWING HIS CROWN | DA CHAMPION ANSWERS EVERY CHALLENGE WIT DA SAME ARGUMENT}!
1118: {DA FIRST CHORD, AN' EVERY ENDIN' IZ ALREADY WRITTEN IN IT | HEAR DA OPENIN', AN' KNOW HOW DIS WILL CLOSE}. {WAGNER MADE DA EARTH SHAKE BEFORE DA CURTAIN ROSE | DA THEME OF YA FALL, STATED ONCE, AT FULL VOICE}!
1119: {EVERYTINK, ALL OF IT, NOW, AN' NUTTIN' HELD BACK | DA LAST ACT, DA FULL COMPANY, DA WHOLE HOUSE BURNIN' BRIGHT}. {THREE TIMES DA MUSIC SWELLS, AN' THREE TIMES IT FALLS ON DEM | DERE IZ NO ENCORE AFTER DIS, AN' NONE IZ NEEDED}!
1131: {LOOK UPON DA FOE UNTIL DA FOE IZ LAID BARE | SUN TZU TAUGHT IT FIRST: KNOW DA BAD 'UN, AN' A HUNDRED BATTLES HOLD NO PERIL | EVERY WALL HAB ONE STONE SET BADLY; DA CAPTAIN FINDS IT BEFORE DA SIEGE}. {NAME DA FLAW ALOUD AN' DA WHOLE COMPANY STRIKES IT | WHAT HAB BIN SEEN NO CAN HIDE AGAIN}!
1132: {PRINT HIS NAME IN BLACK AN' EVERY HAND TURNS AGAINST HIM | DA HERALDS OF OLD NAMED DA TRAITOR AT DA CITY GATE, AN' DA CITY DID DA REST | A REPUTATION FALLS FASTER DEN ANY WALL}. {HE IZ MARKED, AN' DA MARK DOES NO WASH OFF | FROM DIS HOUR HE BLEEDS FOR EVERY BLOW}!
1133: {ONE VOICE, LOUD AS A TRUMPET, AN' DA DREAMERS WAKE | STENTOR OF DA ACHAEANS SHOUTED WIT DA VOICE OF FIFTY MEN | DA WAR SHOUT BREAKS EVERY SPELL LAID ON A SOLDIER'S MIND}. {ON YA FEET, EYES FRONT, HANDS ON STEEL | WAKE, AN' REMEMBER WHOM YOU SERVE}!
1134: {DA ONE WHO CRIES FIRST IZ DA ONE DA BAD 'UN SEES | TYRTAEUS SANG DA SPARTANS INTO DA LINE, AN' DA LINE HELD | A BATTLE CRY IZ A BANNER MADE OF BREATH}. {LET DEM COME AT ME; YOU STRIKE WHILE DEY DO | ME VOICE FOR YA BLADES, ME BODY FOR YA SHIELD}!
1135: {PERICLES SPOKE OVER DA DEAD, AN' DA LIVIN' STOOD TALLER | WE FEW, WE HAPPY FEW: DA WORDS OUTLAST DA KING WHO SPOKE DEM | A SPEECH IZ SLOW, AN' IT IZ DA STRONGEST TINK A LEADER OWNS}. {HEAR ME TA DA END, AN' DEN GO AN' DO IT | WHAT ME SAY NOW, YOU WILL CARRY INTO DA BLOW}!
1136: {DIVIDE AN' RULE: ROME WROTE IT ON EVERY BORDER SHE HELD | ONE WORD DROPPED AMONG BAD 'UNS DOES DA WORK OF A LEGION | MACHIAVELLI TAUGHT DAT A DIVIDED FOE DEFEATS HIMSELF}. {LET DEM DOUBT EACH OTHER, AN' DEY HANDS WILL SLOW | DA SEED IZ LIL'; DA HARVEST IZ DEY RUIN}!
1137: {SHIELD TA SHIELD, DA PHALANX IZ ONE BEAST WIT A HUNDRED HEARTS | DA SACRED BAND OF THEBES NEVER BROKE, FOR NO MAN WOULD SHAME DA ONE BESIDE HIM | CLOSE DA RANKS; DERE IZ NO GAPS IN A WALL OF BROTHERS}. {YA WOUND IZ ME WOUND, AN' WE MEND TOGETHER | WE STAND AS ONE, OR WE DO NO STAND}!
1139: {DA GENERAL SEES DA SEAM IN DA ARMOUR AN' NAMES IT FOR EVERY BLADE | VEGETIUS WROTE DAT DA WISE COMMANDER STRIKES WHERE DA BAD 'UN IZ NO READY | STRATEGY IZ DA ART OF CHOOSIN' DA SINGLE POINT}. {DERE. STRIKE DERE, ALL OF YOU | ONE MARK, AN' EVERY HAND FINDS IT}!
1140: {DA ENVOY WALKS BETWEEN DA ARMIES AN' NO SPEAR IZ RAISED | HERALDS CARRIED DA STAFF OF HERMES, AN' TA STRIKE ONE WAZ SACRILEGE | LAY DOWN YA SWORD FIRST, AN' DA BAD 'UN WILL LOWER HIS}. {ME COME UNDER DA WHITE SIGN; LET NO HAND TOUCH ME | PEACE IZ A SHIELD ONLY DA BOLD CAN CARRY}!
1141: {LOOK AT ME | DA SKIRMISHER DANCES BEFORE DA LINE SO DA LINE MAY STRIKE UNSEEN | HORATIUS HELD DA BRIDGE ALONE, AN' EVERY SPEAR CAME TA HIM}. {COME, ALL OF YOU, IF YOU CAN CATCH ME | ME IZ DA LURE, AN' ME IZ NEVER WHERE YA BLADE FALLS}!
1142: {DA HERO RISES, AN' EVERY SOLDIER RISES WIT HIM | ACHILLES RETURNED TA DA FIELD AN' DA TROJANS BROKE AT DA SOUND OF HIS VOICE | WHEN ALL SEEMS LOST, DA TRUE COMMANDER IZ FIRST SEEN}. {NOW, ALL OF YOU, AS ONE, AS NEVER BEFORE | FOLLOW ME, AN' BE MORE DEN YOU IZ}!
1143: {BREAK DA WILL AN' DA BODY FOLLOWS | SUN TZU HELD DAT DA SUPREME ART IZ TA SUBDUE DA BAD 'UN WITOUT FIGHTIN' | HANNIBAL'S ELEPHANTS WON WIT DA FEAR DEY CARRIED}. {YA GODS HAB LEFT YOU, YA ALLIES HAB FLED, YA ARMS IZ ALREADY HEAVY | LOOK AT WHAT STANDS BEFORE YOU, AN' DESPAIR}!
1144: {A WORD IN DA EAR BEFORE DA CLASH: LET HIM COME, AN' ANSWER | DA FENCIN' MASTERS OF BOLOGNA TAUGHT DA RIPOSTE BEFORE DA ATTACK | WAIT FOR HIS BLADE, AN' HIS BLADE WILL OPEN HIM}. {EVERY BLOW HE GIVES, YOU RETURN | STAND READY; DA ANSWER IZ ALREADY IN YA HAND}!
1145: {MANY HANDS, ONE RHYTHM | DA ROMAN LEGION WHEELED AT A SINGLE TRUMPET NOTE | DA TEN THOUSAND OF XENOPHON MARCHED THROUGH AN EMPIRE COZ DEY MOVED AS ONE}. {MOVE WHEN ME MOVE; STRIKE WHEN ME STRIKE | DA COMPANY FLOWS LIKE WATER, AN' WATER FINDS EVERY GAP}!
1146: {SHIELDS UP BEFORE DA ARROWS LEAVE DA STRING | DA TESTUDO OF ROME MADE A COHORT INTO A TORTOISE OF IRON | FABIUS WON BY REFUSIN' DA BLOW, AN' ROME NAMED HIM HER SHIELD}. {HOLD. LET DEM BREAK UPON US | BRACE, AN' GIVE DEM NUTTIN'}!
1147: {DA ONE WHO WOULD LEAD OTHERS MUST FIRST MASTER HIMSELF | MARCUS AURELIUS RULED AN EMPIRE AN' WROTE ONLY OF RULIN' HIS OWN SOUL | KNOW THYSELF, CARVED ABOVE DA DOOR AT DELPHI}. {ME BECOME WHAT ME WAZ ALWAYS MEANT TA BE | EVERY POWER ME OWN, ME NOW TAKE IN HAND}!
1148: {CAESAR SPOKE TA DA TENTH, AN' DA TENTH WOULD HAB FOLLOWED HIM INTO DA SEA | A SOLDIER FED ON PURPOSE MARCHES FARTHER DEN ONE FED ON BREAD | DA FIRE IZ LIT WIT WORDS AN' BURNS THROUGH DA WHOLE BATTLE}. {YOU WAZ MADE FOR DIS DAY | KEEP FAITH, AN' YA STRENGTH WILL NO RUN DRY}!
1149: {STAND TALL, SAY NUTTIN', AN' LET HIM FEEL DA WEIGHT OF IT | DA SPARTANS COMBED DEY HAIR BEFORE THERMOPYLAE, AN' DA PERSIANS WAZ AFRAID | FEAR IZ A BLADE DAT CUTS BEFORE DA STEEL IZ DRAWN}. {KNEEL, OR BE MADE TA | HIS ARM GROWS HEAVY UNDER ME STARE}!
1150: {STRIKE DA MIND, AN' DA HAND FORGETS ITS PURPOSE | CONFUSION IN DA BAD 'UN'S COUNCILS IZ WORTH AN ARMY IN DA FIELD | DA DRUMS OF DA MONGOLS BEAT UNTIL DA BAD 'UN COULD NO LONGER TINK}. {YA THOUGHTS SCATTER LIKE STARTLED BIRDS | NO PLAN SURVIVES ME VOICE}!
1151: {ANGER DA GENERAL, AN' HE WILL MARCH INTO DA TRAP HIMSELF | SUN TZU WROTE: IF YA OPPONENT IZ OF CHOLERIC TEMPER, IRRITATE HIM | DA WISE PROVOKE; DA FOOLISH IZ PROVOKED}. {COME ON, DEN, AN' LEAVE YA GUARD BEHIND | RAGE BLINDS, AN' DA BLIND IZ EASY PREY}!
1152: {DA WAR IZ WON IN DA MIND BEFORE IT IZ FOUGHT ON DA FIELD | GENGHIS KHAN SENT WORD AHEAD OF HIS ARMIES, AN' CITIES OPENED DEY GATES | EVERY DOUBT PLANTED IZ A SOLDIER HE LOSES}. {YOU IZ ALONE, YOU IZ OUTMATCHED, YOU IZ ALREADY BEATEN | FEEL YA STRENGTH LEAVE YOU, PIECE BY PIECE}!
1153: {PRAISE DA BAD 'UN, AN' WATCH HIM WONDER WHY | DA COURTIER'S ART: A KIND WORD WIT A BLADE FOLDED INSIDE IT | CASTIGLIONE TAUGHT DAT GRACE DISARMS MORE SURELY DEN STEEL}. {SUCH FINE ARMOUR, AN' SO POORLY FASTENED | HE SMILES, AN' DOES NO SEE DA OPENIN' HE GIVES}!
1154: {LET HIM BELIEVE HE HAB ALREADY WON | PRIDE GOES BEFORE DA FALL, AN' DA FALL IZ OURS TA ARRANGE | XERXES WATCHED FROM HIS THRONE, CERTAIN, AN' SALAMIS TOOK HIS FLEET}. {SWING HARD, DEN, AN' TRUST YA LUCK NO FURTHER | DA PROUD MAN STRIKES BOLDLY AN' SEES NUTTIN'}!
1155: {MAKE HIM FEAR DA BLOW DAT NEVER COMES | A FOE BEHIND HIS SHIELD IZ A FOE WHO DOES NO MOVE | DA GREAT WALL KEPT AN EMPIRE STILL}. {HIDE, DEN, AN' BE SLOW IN HIDIN' | WHILE HE GUARDS, WE CHOOSE DA HOUR}!
1156: {TELL HIM TA HOLD, AN' HE WILL LET GO | DA MIND PUSHES AGAINST EVERY HAND LAID ON IT, AN' DA MASTER USES DIS | COMMAND DA OPPOSITE OF WHAT YOU DESIRE, WIT A STRAIGHT FACE AN' A STEADY VOICE}. {KEEP YA BLESSINGS CLOSE, ME TOLD HIM, AN' HE CAST DEM AWAY | HIS STRENGTH FALLS FROM HIM AT ME WORD}!
1157: {BELIEVE IN HIM, AN' HE WILL FORGET TA BE CAREFUL | DA HONEST WORD DAT SENDS A SOLDIER OVER DA WALL | ALEXANDER TOLD HIS MEN DEY WAZ INVINCIBLE, AN' FOR A TIME DEY WAZ}. {GO, AN' DO NO LOOK BACK | STRIKE WIT ALL YOU HAB, AN' LEAVE CAUTION TA DA DEAD}!
1159: {GIVE DA BAD 'UN ORDERS OF HIS OWN, AN' LET DEM BE DA WRONG ONES | A FALSE MESSENGER IN DA NIGHT IZ WORTH A THOUSAND SPEARS | TROY TOOK DA HORSE WITHIN HER WALLS COZ SHE BELIEVED IT WAZ WISDOM}. {CHARGE, ALL OF YOU, AN' LEAVE YA FLANKS OPEN | DEY RUSH IN STRONG, AN' DEY RUSH IN TA DIE}!
1160: {DA BERSERKERS OF DA NORTH WENT INTO BATTLE WITOUT MAIL, AN' NO ONE STOOD BEFORE DEM | WAKE DA BEAST IN HIM AN' POINT IT AT DA FOE | DERE IZ A FURY IN EVERY WARRIOR; DA LEADER OPENS ITS CAGE}. {FORGET YA FEAR, FORGET YA NAME, AN' STRIKE | LET DA RED MIST TAKE YOU}!
1161: {ONE WORD, ONE NOD, AN' DA ARM IZ STEADIER | A CAPTAIN NEED NO SPEAK LONG; HE NEED ONLY BE HEARD | DA SMALLEST SPARK LIGHTS DA DRY WOOD}. {GO ON | YOU HAB DIS; STRIKE}!
1162: {A WHISPER BEFORE DA BLOW: LEFT FOOT, NOW | DA OLD MASTERS TAUGHT DAT DA BEST GUARD IZ NO TA BE DERE | MUSASHI WROTE DAT DA EYE MUST SEE DA FAR AN' DA NEAR ALIKE}. {HIS BLADE COMES HIGH; BE LOW | MOVE AS ME TELL YOU, AN' NUTTIN' WILL TOUCH YOU}!
1163: {EVEN A LIL' WORD CUTS IF IT IZ THROWN FIRST | DA WARRIORS OF DA SAGAS TRADED INSULTS BEFORE DEY TRADED BLOWS | MOCK HIM, AN' HIS BLOOD RUNS HOT AN' HIS ARM RUNS WEAK}. {IZ DAT ALL YOU CARRY | DA FIRST WOUND IZ TA HIS PRIDE}!
1164: {MANY MINDS, ONE PURPOSE, AN' EACH MIND IZ FED BY DA OTHERS | DA COUNCIL OF WAR SHARPENS EVERY CAPTAIN WHO SITS AT IT | THOUGHT SHARED IZ THOUGHT DOUBLED}. {TAKE FROM ME CLARITY WHAT YOU NEED | OUR WITS RUN AS ONE RIVER}!
1165: {CAST OFF EVERY WEIGHT DA BAD 'UN HAB LAID ON YOU | ORDER IZ RESTORED, AN' ORDER IZ STRENGTH | A DISCIPLINED RANK SHAKES OFF A CURSE AS A HORSE SHAKES OFF FLIES}. {STAND CLEAN, STAND WHOLE | NUTTIN' DAT IZ NO OURS REMAINS WIT US}!
1166: {DA COMMANDER SPENDS HIMSELF SO DA COMPANY NEED NO | EVERY ORDER GIVEN IZ STRENGTH HANDED FROM ONE TA MANY | NAPOLEON CARRIED DA WHOLE CAMPAIGN IN HIS HEAD AN' GAVE EACH MARSHAL HIS PART}. {TAKE ME STRENGTH, AN' USE IT WELL | ME IZ EMPTIED, AN' YOU IZ FULL}!
1167: {EVEN DA HARDEST MARCH HAB ITS HALT | DA VETERAN RESTS WHERE HE STANDS AN' RISES AS IF NEW | BREATH IZ DA FIRST WEAPON AN' DA LAST}. {ONE BREATH, DEN ANOTHER, AN' DA FIRE RETURNS | REST NOW, FOR DA NEXT CHARGE IZ YA}!
1168: {NO WASTED STEP, NO WASTED BREATH | FREDERICK OF PRUSSIA DRILLED HIS MEN UNTIL DEY FIRED THREE VOLLEYS TA DA BAD 'UN'S ONE | SPEED IZ DA ESSENCE OF WAR, WROTE SUN TZU}. {FASTER, AN' EVERY BLOW LANDS TRUE | YOU MOVE BEFORE DEY TINK}!
1169: {WHAT IZ HIS BECOMES ME, AN' HE IZ LEFT WIT NUTTIN' | DA CONQUEROR SITS IN DA THRONE HE TAKES | TAKE DA BAD 'UN'S STRENGTH AN' TURN IT UPON HIM}. {YA POWER WAZ ONLY BORROWED | ME CLAIM WHAT YOU THOUGHT WAZ YA}!
1170: {FORWARD, IN ORDER, EVERY EYE ON DA OBJECTIVE | DA OBLIQUE ORDER OF LEUCTRA WON COZ EVERY MAN KNEW WHERE TA STEP | AN ADVANCE IZ A SENTENCE SPOKEN IN STEEL}. {EYES ON DA MARK; NUTTIN' ELSE EXISTS | FORWARD, AN' MISS NUTTIN'}!
1171: {DERE IZ A PRICE ON HIS HEAD, AN' ME HAB COME TA COLLECT IT | DA HUNTER STUDIES DA QUARRY LONGER DEN HE CHASES IT | EVERY MARK HAB A WEAKNESS; DA PROFESSIONAL FINDS IT FIRST}. {RUN, AN' RUN SLOWER | ME KNOW WHERE YOU BLEED}!
1172: {DA NEWS FALLS ON DEM LIKE A HAMMER | WHEN DA HERALD CRIED DAT DA KING WAZ DEAD, DA ARMY FORGOT WHICH WAY TA FACE | A TRUTH SHOUTED AT DA RIGHT HOUR BREAKS A LINE}. {HEAR IT, ALL OF YOU, AN' REEL | DA WORD STRIKES EVERY EAR AT ONCE}!
1173: {DA WISE LORD PREPARES DA RETREAT BEFORE HE GIVES DA ORDER TA ATTACK | XENOPHON BROUGHT TEN THOUSAND HOME COZ HE ALWAYS KNEW DA WAY OUT | NO ONE FALLS WHO HAB BIN CAUGHT}. {FALL, AN' ME WILL CATCH YOU | WE STEP ASIDE, WHOLE, AN' RISE AGAIN}!
1174: {A WOUNDED MAN WHO BELIEVES IN HIS CAPTAIN IZ HALF HEALED | NAPOLEON HELD DAT DA MORAL IZ TA DA PHYSICAL AS THREE IZ TA ONE | DA HAND ON DA SHOULDER CLOSES DA WOUND}. {RISE; YOU IZ NO FINISHED | YA BLOOD IZ STILL YA, AN' SO IZ YA STRENGTH}!
1175: {DA ORDER IZ GIVEN, AN' DA ORDER IZ FINAL | WHEN DA SOVEREIGN SPEAKS, STEEL OBEYS | DERE IZ NO APPEAL FROM DIS DECREE}. {FALL, AS YOU WAZ ALREADY FALLIN' | DA WORD IZ LAW, AN' DA LAW CUTS}!
1176: {NO SOLDIER OF ME STAYS DOWN WHILE ME STILL HAB BREATH | ROLAND SOUNDED DA HORN AT RONCEVAUX, AN' DA DEAD HEARD IT | DA CRY REACHES PAST DA EDGE OF DA DARK}. {RISE. WE IZ NO DONE | YA PLACE IN DA LINE IZ WAITIN'}!
1177: {HONOUR IZ FOR DOZE WHO CAN AFFORD TA LOSE | DA MERCENARY FIGHTS TA WIN, AN' NUTTIN' ELSE IZ WRITTEN IN HIS CONTRACT | STRIKE DA MAN WHO IZ DOWN, FOR HE WILL NO STAY DOWN}. {NO WITNESSES, NO MERCY | WHILE YOU STRUGGLE, ME END IT}!
1178: {EVERY SECRET DRAGGED INTO DA LIGHT WEAKENS DA ONE WHO KEPT IT | DA TRUTH IZ A WEAPON, AN' IT IZ SHARPEST WHEN IT IZ WHOLE | TACITUS WROTE DOWN DA CRIMES OF EMPERORS, AN' DA EMPERORS IZ REMEMBERED FOR NUTTIN' ELSE}. {STAND NAKED BEFORE DA WORLD | YOU IZ SEEN, AN' WHAT IZ SEEN CAN BE STRUCK}!
1179: {DA FORTUNE DAT ROSE IN A YEAR FALLS IN AN HOUR | KINGS HAB BIN RUINED BY DA PRICE OF GRAIN MORE SURELY DEN BY DA SWORD | ALL DAT HE OWNS WILL BE COUNTED, AN' DEN IT WILL BE OURS}. {YA WEALTH TURNS TA DUST IN YA HAND | FALL, AN' PAY TWICE OVER}!
1180: {FIRE UPON DEM, AN' LET DA EARTH ITSELF RISE | NAPOLEON WAZ A GUNNER FIRST, AN' DA GUNS MADE HIM EMPEROR | GOD FIGHTS ON DA SIDE WIT DA BEST ARTILLERY}. {EVERY GUN, NOW | BURN DEM WHERE DEY STAND}!
1181: {DA MERCENARY IZ PAID FOR ONE BLOW, AN' HE MAKES IT COUNT | GOLD BUYS DA ARM, AN' DA ARM DOES NO HOLD BACK | DA SWISS PIKES BROKE EVERY GUARD IN EUROPE FOR DEY WAGE}. {DIS IZ WHAT ME IZ PAID FOR | YA GUARD BREAKS, AN' DA CONTRACT IZ FULFILLED}!
1182: {A FLASH OF LIGHT, AN' DA BAD 'UN SEES NUTTIN' BUT WHITE | DA SIGNAL MIRRORS OF DA OLD ARMIES BLINDED BEFORE DEY STRUCK | LIGHT IZ DA OLDEST WEAPON OF DA WATCHER}. {LOOK AT ME | BLIND, AN' OPEN}!
1183: {DOZE WHO STAND UNDER ME AUTHORITY STAND BEYOND DA REACH OF CURSES | DA SOVEREIGN'S WORD IZ A SEAL, AN' NO SPELL BREAKS DA SEAL | WHAT ME PROTECT, NO POISON TOUCHES}. {YOU IZ ME, AN' NO OTHER MAY CLAIM YOU | UNDER ME HAND, YA MINDS IZ UNTOUCHABLE}!
1184: {DA BATTLE IZ FOUGHT A HUNDRED TIMES IN DA COMMANDER'S MIND BEFORE IT IZ FOUGHT ONCE | HANNIBAL AT CANNAE LET DA ROMANS ADVANCE INTO DA JAWS HE HAB BUILT | EVERY BLOW DEY THROW HAB ALREADY BIN ANSWERED}. {LET DEM STRIKE; EACH STRIKE IZ DEY UNDOIN' | DA TRAP IZ SET, AN' YOU IZ ITS TEETH}!
1185: {DA OLD SOLDIER HAB BLED BEFORE, AN' KNOWS HOW TA STOP IT | SCARS IZ DA VETERAN'S GRIMORIE, AN' HE READS DEM ALOUD | WHAT KILLS DA RECRUIT ONLY SLOWS DA VETERAN}. {BIND IT, BREATHE, STAND | ME HAB SEEN WORSE, AN' SO WILL YOU}!
1186: {DA DEED IZ TOLD, AN' EVERY MAN WHO HEARS IT GROWS | HOMER GAVE ACHILLES A GLORY DAT OUTLIVED TROY | FAME IZ DA WINE OF SOLDIERS}. {YA NAMES WILL BE WRITTEN, AN' READ | FIGHT AS IF DA WHOLE WORLD WAZ WATCHIN'}!
1187: {HE WHO HOLDS DA MARKET HOLDS DA CITY | DA MERCHANT PRINCES OF VENICE RULED DA SEA WITOUT A SINGLE CROWN | CONTROL DA BREAD, AN' YOU CONTROL DA PEOPLE}. {KNEEL BEFORE WHAT YOU NO CAN AFFORD | YA STRENGTH HAB A PRICE, AN' DA PRICE IZ BEYOND YOU}!
1188: {YOU IZ DISMISSED, FROM DIS FIELD AN' FROM DIS LIFE | DA DECREE OF EXILE WAZ OLDER DEN DA SWORD AN' CUT DEEPER | ONE WORD FROM DA MASTER, AN' DA MIND BREAKS}. {YA SERVICE IZ ENDED | GO, AN' TAKE NUTTIN' WIT YOU}!
1189: {A FAIR TRADE STRENGTHENS BOTH HANDS | DA MERCHANTS OF DA SILK ROAD CROSSED DESERTS ON A HANDSHAKE | WHAT ME GIVE YOU NOW, YOU WILL REPAY WIT DA BLADE}. {TAKE IT; DA PRICE IZ VICTORY | STRENGTH FOR STRENGTH, AN' WE IZ EVEN}!
1190: {GOLD OPENS EVERY DOOR AN' BREAKS EVERY HEAD | BYZANTIUM BOUGHT OFF MORE BAD 'UNS DEN SHE EVER KILLED | COIN, FLUNG HARD, IZ AS HEAVY AS ANY STONE}. {TAKE IT, AN' TAKE IT AGAIN | HERE IZ YA WAGE}!
1191: {DA BEST OF DA STORES IZ KEPT FOR DA ONE WHO NEEDS IT MOST | A GOOD QUARTERMASTER WINS MORE BATTLES DEN A GOOD GENERAL | WHAT IZ RARE IZ GIVEN ONLY ONCE, AN' GIVEN WELL}. {DRINK, AN' BE WHOLE | DIS IZ DA FINEST ME HAB; IT IZ YA}!
1192: {EVERY BAD 'UN IZ A FORTUNE WAITIN' TA BE TAKEN | DA CONQUISTADORS WEIGHED DA EMPIRE IN GOLD BEFORE DEY FOUGHT FOR IT | WAR IZ COMMERCE BY OTHER MEANS}. {YA LIVES IZ PRICED, AN' DA PRICE IZ ME | RUN HEAVY, DIE RICH, AN' LEAVE IT ALL TA US}!
1204: {RISE, AN' LET DA LIL' MAKERS MEND WHAT DA BLADE HAB OPENED | TEN THOUSAND HANDS TOO FINE TA SEE, AN' EVERY ONE OF DEM IZ YA}. {STEEL IN DA BLOOD, SPEED IN DA STEP | DA WOUND CLOSES WHILE DA FIGHT GOES ON}!
1205: {STAND INSIDE DA LIGHT AN' NUTTIN' FOUL WILL REACH YOU | A WALL WIT NO WEIGHT, RAISED AT DA SPEED OF THOUGHT}. {HOLD DA LINE, AN' DA FIELD HOLDS YOU | WHAT STRIKES DA SHIELD DOES NO STRIKE DA SOUL}!
1206: {FIRE TAKES, AN' WE GIVE BACK | COOL WATER, CLEAN HANDS, STEADY HEART: SO DA VIGILES OF ROME WAZ TAUGHT}. {NO ONE BURNS WHILE ME STAND | DA FLAME HAB HAB ITS TURN; NOW IT IZ OURS}!
1207: {DA AXE OPENS ONLY DA WAY | IRON AGAINST IRON, AN' DA TRAPPED WALK FREE}. {NO CHAIN, NO HOLD, NO ICE KEEPS ME PEOPLE | STRIKE DA BOND, SPARE DA BOUND}!
1208: {EVERY WALL IZ A DOOR TA DA ONE WHO WILL NO STAY | SUN TZU LEFT DA BESIEGED A ROAD OUT, AN' SO DO WE}. {GO, ALL OF YOU; ME HOLD DA THRESHOLD | LIVE TODAY, RETURN TOMORROW}!
1209: {PRESSURE ON DA WOUND, EYES ON DA HORIZON | LARREY CARRIED DA FALLEN FROM DA FIELD UNDER CANNON FIRE, AN' DA ART REMEMBERS HIM}. {BLEED NO MORE; DA POISON IZ ME NOW | YOU IZ NO DONE, NO TODAY}!

1777: {BY DA FOUR NAMES AT DA FOUR QUARTERS, ME OPEN DA GATE, AN' ME ALONE SHALL CLOSE IT. | ME CONJURE THEE, GRAVITY WELL, AGAINST EVERY BAD 'UN, AN' ME CONJURE THEE IN WRATH. | O SPIRIT DAT RULEST DA KINETIC, HEAR DA VOICE OF DA OPERATOR, WHO CALLS THEE BY THINE OFFICE.} {EVERY SCHOOL SINCE IZ COMMENTARY ON DIS ONE LAW, AN' DIS LAW IZ STILL DA SHARPEST. | RAW POWER IZ SHAPED BY SIGN AN' WORD, AN' IT STRIKES EXACTLY WHERE IT IZ SENT. | DA PURE ART, STRIPPED OF ORNAMENT: FORCE, BOUNDED AN' DIRECTED.} {DA BLOW FALLS FROM A TINK DAT WAZ TOLD TA STRIKE, AN' IT DOES NO HESITATE. | DA KINETIC IZ FETCHED FROM ELSEWHERE, AN' DA WORD IZ WHAT FETCHES IT. | DA NAME HAB POWER OVER DA TINK COZ DA TINK CONSENTED ONCE, BEFORE DA WORLD, AN' WAZ NEVER RELEASED.}

1782: {DA WEAPON IZ AN EXTENSION OF DA BODY, AN' DA BODY PUTS EVERYTINK BEHIND IT | DA MASTERS OF DA LONG STICK AN' DA SHORT BLADE TEACH DA SAME RULE: COMMIT}. {FULL WEIGHT BEHIND DA WEAPON | DA STRIKE CARRIES DA NATURE OF WHAT IZ IN DA HAND | SLOW, DELIBERATE, FINAL}. {POWER | FEEL DA WEIGHT}!
1783: {DA HEAVY BLOW CRACKS DA ARMOUR BEFORE IT CRACKS DA MAN | DA OLD BRAWLERS KNEW DAT A HEAVY HAND WEARS DOWN DA STRONGEST GUARD}. {HEAVY, AN' DA DEFENCE BUCKLES | HIT DA SHELL UNTIL IT BREAKS | DA BLOW DAT SOFTENS EVERYTINK AFTER IT}. {AGAIN, HARDER | FEEL DAT THROUGH DA ARMOUR}!
1784: {DA QUICK JAB IZ DA FIRST PUNCH A BOXER LEARNS AN' DA LAST HE STOPS THROWIN' | FAST, LIGHT, AN' CONSTANT: DA JAB BUILDS DA FIGHT}. {SNAP, AN' BACK | LIL', QUICK, AN' IT NEVER STOPS | DA JAB KEEPS DA RHYTHM}. {QUICK | BUILDIN'}!
1785: {DA UPPERCUT IZ DA PUNCH DAT WAITS FOR DA MAN TA BEND | DA BODY BLOW BRINGS DA HEAD DOWN, AN' DA UPPERCUT IZ WAITIN' DERE}. {BENT OVER AN' GASPIN', AN' DA CHIN IZ ME | UP FROM DA FLOOR, INTO DA JAW | BREATHLESS, AN' DEN AIRBORNE}. {UP | CATCH YA BREATH ON DA WAY DOWN}!
1786: {DA TURNIN' KICK OF TAE KWON DO, DOLLYEO CHAGI, TURNS DA HIP AN' WHIPS DA SHIN AROUND | ONCE DA EYE HAB MARKED DA TARGET, DA KICK KNOWS DA ROAD}. {TURN, AN' DA SHIN FINDS WHAT DA EYE CHOSE | LOCKED ON, AN' NUTTIN' CAN MOVE FAST ENOUGH | DA KICK DAT WAZ AIMED BEFORE IT WAZ THROWN}. {MARKED, AN' HIT | DERE}!
1787: {DA CRUSHIN' BLOW BREAKS DA ARMOUR AN' LEAVES DA BODY NAKED TA DA NEXT | DA SIEGE RAMS OF OLD BROKE GATES; DA CRUSHIN' BLOW BREAKS MEN}. {CRUSH DA SHELL, AN' DA SOFT IZ EXPOSED | HEAVY, SLOW, AN' NUTTIN' HOLDS AGAINST IT | AFTER DIS, EVERY BLOW HURTS MORE}. {CRUSHED | NOW YOU CAN FEEL EVERYTINK}!
1788: {TWO CUTS ALONG ONE LINE, DA SECOND DEEPER DEN DA FIRST | DA FIRST OPENS DA ROAD; DA SECOND WALKS IT}. {AGAINST DA STAGGERIN', DA SECOND IZ DA END | DERE IZ NO TIME TA RECOVER BETWEEN DEM}!
1789: {DA HEADBUTT IZ DA OLDEST STRIKE OF DA GLASGOW STREETS AN' DA BRETON WRESTLERS ALIKE | DA SKULL IZ DA HARDEST BONE, AN' IT DOES NO ASK WHOSE SKULL IZ HARDER}. {FOREHEAD TA FACE | BOTH OF US WILL FEEL IT. YOU MORE | DA HARDEST BONE, AT DA CLOSEST RANGE}. {BRACE | WHO HAB DA HARDER HEAD?}!
1790: {DA STOMP IZ DA OLDEST BLOW OF ALL, OLDER DEN ANY SCHOOL: DA FOOT COMIN' DOWN ON WHAT IZ BENEATH IT | DA PINNED MAN NO CAN MOVE, AN' DA HEEL DOES NO NEED TA AIM}. {DOWN, ONTO WHAT LIES BELOW | PINNED BENEATH ME, AN' DA HEEL FALLS | WHAT IZ UNDER ME FOOT DOES NO GET UP}. {STAY DOWN | CRUSHED UNDER HEEL}!
1791: {REVERSE DA BLADE, AN' DA HILT BECOMES DA HAMMER | WHERE DA GUARD IZ BROKEN, DA HILT FINISHES IT | DA MORDHAU: CROSS AN' POMMEL DRIVEN AS ONE}. {DOWN, AN' STAY DOWN | WHAT WAZ CRACKED IZ NOW SHATTERED}!
1792: {DA BODY CHECK BREAKS DA STANCE BEFORE DA STANCE CAN BE USED | WHOEVER SETS A GUARD, A COUNTER OR A FLOW HAB MADE A PLAN, AN' DA SHOULDER BREAKS PLANS}. {SHOULDER FIRST, AN' EVERY PLAN FALLS APART | INTO DEM, THROUGH DEY GUARD, THROUGH DEY STANCE | NO TIME TA SET, NO TIME TA ANSWER}. {YA PLAN IZ GONE | OFF BALANCE, OUT OF RHYTHM}!

DEN LOOSE}. {IT COMES LAST, AN' IT COMES ONCE, AN' ONCE IZ ENOUGH | STEEL ANSWERS STEEL, AN' DA BOLT HAB DA FINAL WORD}!

1800: {SWIFT AS DA CAT, FOUL AS DA GUTTER | DA SCRATCH IZ SHALLOW; DA FEVER IT BRINGS IZ NO}. {STRIKE FIRST AN' LET DA ROT DO DA REST | FOUR LINES, AN' DA SICKNESS ENTERS}!

DA CASTER STANDS IN DA WAY OF DA FALL.} {COLD IZ SLOW, AN' SLOW IZ ITS WEAPON: IT ARRIVES WHILE DA TARGET STILL HESITATES. | HEAT IZ TORN OUT, AN' WHAT REMAINS IZ DA SHAPE OF DA TAKIN'. | WATER IZ PATIENT, AN' ICE IZ WATER DAT HAB CEASED TA FORGIVE.} {HEAT GOES FROM WARM TA COLD AN' ASKS NUTTIN'. {OAK AN' ASH AN' THORN, DA THREE DAT NEVER BOWED: STAND WIT ME NOW. | STONE, AN' MOSS, AN' DA DEEP WATER UNDER BOTH: RISE, AN' BE SWIFT. | RAIN DAT HAB FALLEN, RAIN DAT FALLS, RAIN DAT WILL FALL: ME SET ME HAND IN ALL THREE.} {DA DEEP IZ CALLED UP, AN' DA DEEP DOES NO GIVE BACK WHAT IT TAKES. | IT CARRIES, IT DROWNS, IT WEARS AWAY, AN' IT IZ DA ONE SUBSTANCE DOING ALL THREE. | WATER IZ ONLY UNLEASHED, AN' DAT IZ ENOUGH.} {MOON OVER DA FURROW, PULL AS THOU PULLEST DA TIDE, AN' DA FIELD MOVES WIT THEE. | NO PLEADIN', NO THANKS. ME SAY IT PLAINLY, AS DA HARD WINTER SAYS IT. | BRAMBLE TA DA FLESH, NETTLE TA DA EYE, AN' DA THORN TA DA HEART BEHIND DA RIBS.}

DA FIELD DOES DA GROWIN' AN' TAKES ITS DUE.} {BURN DA THORN DAT WAZ USED. NEVER LEAVE A THORN LYING WIT A NAME UPON IT. | SAY NUTTIN' ON DA ROAD BACK. DA SAYIN' IZ DONE. | LEAVE AN OFFERIN'. ME SAY IT PLAINLY, AS DA HARD WINTER SAYS IT. | WHAT WAZ SLOW, BE SUDDEN. WHAT WAZ SUDDEN, BE SLOW. DA YEAR IZ ONE, AN' FOR DIS MOMENT IT IZ ME. | BRAMBLE TA DA FLESH, NETTLE TA DA EYE, AN' DA THORN TA DA HEART BEHIND DA RIBS.}

DA SAYIN' IZ DONE. | WHERE DA WORKIN' STRUCK, NUTTIN' RISES NEXT YEAR. SO IT HAB ALWAYS BIN.}
